card_mod.style: #root { gap: 20px; padding: 20px 24px; box-sizing: border-box; } #root > * { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }

style.ha-markdown$: h1 { font-size: 96px; font-weight: 300; margin: 0; line-height: 1.05; } h3 { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 400; margin: 4px 0 10px; } p { margin: 0; }
ha-card { background: none; box-shadow: none; border: none; font-size: 24px; padding: 0 4px; }

cards.content:
{% set d = states('sensor.trash_pickup') | int(-1) %}{% if d == 0 %} Trash pickup is today
{% elif d == 1 %} Trash goes out tonight
{% endif %}{% if states('sensor.bath_screen_mode') == 'evening' %}{% set unlocked = ['lock.front_door', 'lock.back_door', 'lock.storage_room_lock'] | select('is_state', 'unlocked') | map('state_attr', 'friendly_name') | map('replace', ' Lock', '') | list %}{% set open_ = ['cover.small_garage_door', 'cover.large_garage_door'] | select('is_state', 'open') | map('state_attr', 'friendly_name') | list %}{% for u in unlocked %} {{ u }} is unlocked
{% endfor %}{% for o in open_ %} {{ o }} is open
{% endfor %}{% if not unlocked and not open_ %} Doors locked, garage doors closed
{% endif %} Alarm {{ states('alarm_control_panel.alarmo') | replace('_', ' ') }}{% else %} Sunrise {{ as_timestamp(state_attr('sun.sun', 'next_rising')) | timestamp_custom('%-I:%M %p') }} · sunset {{ as_timestamp(state_attr('sun.sun', 'next_setting')) | timestamp_custom('%-I:%M %p') }}{% endif %}

style.ha-markdown$: h2 { font-size: 38px !important; font-weight: 400 !important; margin: 0 0 10px !important; } p { margin: 0; }
h2 { font-size: 32px !important; font-weight: 400 !important; margin: 0 0 6px !important; } p { margin: 0 0 14px; } ha-icon { --mdc-icon-size: 28px; margin-right: 6px; }

cards.content:
{% set days = state_attr('sensor.bath_screen_forecast', 'days') or [] %}{% set icon = {'sunny': 'weather-sunny', 'clear-night': 'weather-night', 'partlycloudy': 'weather-partly-cloudy', 'cloudy': 'weather-cloudy', 'rainy': 'weather-rainy', 'pouring': 'weather-pouring', 'snowy': 'weather-snowy', 'snowy-rainy': 'weather-snowy-rainy', 'lightning': 'weather-lightning', 'lightning-rainy': 'weather-lightning-rainy', 'fog': 'weather-fog', 'hail': 'weather-hail', 'windy': 'weather-windy', 'windy-variant': 'weather-windy-variant'} %}{% if days %}{% for d in days %}{% endfor %}{% for d in days %}{% endfor %}{% for d in days %}{% endfor %}{% for d in days %}{% endfor %}{% if days | selectattr('precip', 'ge', 0.01) | list %}{% for d in days %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}
{{ d.day }}
{{ d.high }}°
{{ d.low }}°
{{ (d.precip | round(2) ~ ' in') if d.precip >= 0.01 else '' }}
{% else %}Forecast unavailable{% endif %}
